The bowl is a large stainless mixing bowl, so I treated it as wider than the default 15 cm. The chicken pile spans roughly 45% of the bowl's width, about 10–12 cm across.

The food is diced cooked chicken breast in a single layer of cubes. I counted about 40 cubes at roughly 1.5–2 cm each, which works out to around 120 g.

Cooked chicken breast has about 165 kcal per 100 g, giving roughly 200 kcal. There is no visible oil or sauce, so I added nothing for that.
